Remove one or more Parameter Identification tasks from a Project

Source: R/parameter-identification.R
removePITask.Rd

Drop the tasks with matching ids in one write-through. Warns (and skips) any id not present.

Usage

removePITask(project, id)

Arguments

project

A Project object.

id

Character vector of task ids. Each is canonicalized the same way addPITask() canonicalizes it.

Value

The project object, invisibly.

Details

addPITask() is not vectorized over ids: each task is composed of its own distinct lists of PIParameter / PIOutputMapping records, so several tasks are added with several calls. The per-task sub-definition helpers (addPIParameter() / addPIOutputMapping() and their removals) act on one parent task identified by task, so they likewise stay single-definition.

See also

Other parameterIdentification: PIOutputMapping(), PIParameter(), PITask(), addPIOutputMapping(), addPIParameter(), addPITask(), removePIOutputMapping(), removePIParameter()
